verdict: Round 1 COMPLETELY CLEAN — 0 findings of any severity across 15 fresh sequential agents, ~200+ runtime assertions. Every feature behavior exercised against the real RAILS_ENV=test app (models, interactors, jobs, policy, serializer, and full authenticated HTTP for controller create + end-to-end review blocking). No OpenAI was ever called (queue_adapter=:test + extractor/Orchestrate stubs). The core guarantee — a zero-criteria job blocks new AI summary reviews (manual + bulk) with the exact message, no credit consumed — is verified end-to-end through the real request stack. Need one more clean round to converge.
